status: Mapping only. Bicora does not compute, store or serve on-chain TVL from this file, and it is not a Risk Index input. Protocol TVL and all scores keep using DefiLlama. When a calculation is built on this mapping it is intended to run as a parallel comparison against DefiLlama.

evidence.source: Read from the protocol's published Clarity source on GitHub (contract IDs, constants, function names). Not yet confirmed against mainnet state.
evidence.documented: Stated in protocol documentation or audits; not read from source.
evidence.unverified: Inferred. Must be confirmed before use.
evidence.onchain: Confirmed against mainnet by `npm run tvl:verify`. No entry has this status yet.

rules: Net TVL counts the underlying tokens held by the mapped holder contracts. Borrowed value is excluded from TVL and reported separately, matching DefiLlama's convention for lending markets.
Share and receipt tokens (Zest ztokens, zvstBTC) are never counted. Only the underlying asset they represent is.
Zest v0-market-vault holds posted collateral: count only underlying assets it holds. Ztokens it holds are shares of Zest vaults that are already counted.
The Zest stBTC strategy vault (zvstBTC) is not counted as a separate position: its zstBTC collateral sits in v0-vault-stbtc. Only idle stBTC / sBTC held by its state and ops contracts is added.

stSTX, stSTXbtc and stBTC held by Zest are claims on StackingDAO's backing. Per-protocol TVL counts them in both protocols (as DefiLlama does); any ecosystem total must subtract holdings marked backedBy.
Prices are not chosen yet. priceRef records what each asset needs; derivative tokens also need the ratio named in ratio.

wSTX.note: Zest wrapper. v0-vault-stx moves native STX (with-stx), so its holding is measured as the vault's native STX balance.

ratio.note: STX per stSTX. Data Core v3 is named in StackingDAO docs; the read-only function is not confirmed.
Swaps with stSTX-backed STX 1:1 per StackingDAO docs.
Called by Zest zv-engine-stbtc-0; returns sBTC per stBTC, scaled (scale to confirm on-chain).

holders.note: Receives collateral by token transfer (traditional mode) and ztokens (rehypothecated mode). Count underlying balances only.
zvstBTC strategy vault idle balances, as summed by zv-engine-stbtc-0 compute-gross-nav.

excluded.reason: Share token of the strategy vault; its positions are counted through v0-vault-stbtc and the idle-balance contracts.
Protocol fee treasury, not user deposits. Revisit if fees are held in mapped assets.

holders.note: Vault for all protocol STX. STX delegated to stacking pools and delegates is not in its own balance, so the native balance alone undercounts. A reserve read-only total (function not confirmed) or enumeration of the stacking delegate contracts is needed.
Contract holding sBTC behind stBTC not identified.

crossChecks.name: STX backing from supply
crossChecks.formula: stSTX total supply × STX-per-stSTX + stSTXbtc total supply
